extension.description: VSWML/VSWCSS editing and native VeroScript GUI check, compilation and preview.
setting.entry: GUI entry (.vs or .vswml; .vsapp for check/preview). Empty uses the selected input; a style file uses a sibling .vswml.
setting.environmentPath: Explicit CLI package environment passed with --path. Backend choices precede environment loading.
setting.schemaFiles: Editor hint JSON files extending builtin widget metadata. They do not register runtime bindings or GUI compiler processors.
setting.assets: Files embedded by GUI compilation. Paths use the owning workspace/source directory.
setting.packageName: Package name for compiled GUI applications.
setting.previewFrames: Frame bound for .vswml previews only. Zero leaves the generated loop unbounded; VS entries own their loop.
setting.backends: Platform/graphics/gui/image/font/text-layout backend selection. Empty or omitted values inherit the native environment; auto selects a native candidate and none disables the service.
task.input: GUI entry path, resolved on the workspace extension host. Supports workspaceFolder, file, fileDirname and env variables.
task.args: Preview script arguments. Arrays replace inherited veroscript.run.args.
